implementation_notes: Explicit whole current STYLE_HOME lock format 1/2; no source, route, settings, ref, lock override or project input. Every package must have an authenticated complete approval.
Use one complete snapshot per package: managed, original local source, approved or verified immutable Git cache. Do not splice files; live links require existing trust and exact live bytes.
ReadLocked is an existing-cache-only reader: no Git, directory creation, quarantine, repair or publication. Missing/bad cache may fall back to complete approval.
Settings keys must exactly equal locked keys; values must reproduce canonical source/rendered/native approval bytes, with no default/environment completion.
Joint schema/runtime/requires/native/budget/dedup/replace validation precedes all package/file changes. More than one replace is explicitly rejected.

Rebuild locked adapters without Detect. Exact route/version/root/surface/rendered/trust/fail_closed/static layout and program-path semantics must remain. Existing files requiring changed bytes or removal are refused.

Reuse the T21 guarded transaction: capture once, deep detached confirmation, verify before commit, stage all package repairs before exchanges and one ApplyFiles, inverse rollback and typed retained-backup reporting.
Lock bytes/mode/mtime/inode, approvals and settings are read-only; no runtime state/stats/probe maintenance. No core/index/state schema, protocol, renderer or agenthooks changes.
No-op verifies captured inputs and changes no installation files; recoveries disclose native commands even when already approved. Exit 0/1/4, with 3 reserved for sync.
limits: Existing lock.rendered hashes the last changed-file aggregate, not a full installation manifest. Partial missing renderer outputs may not reproduce it; fail conservatively instead of changing lock or ownership. Complete owner-authorized missing output restores are tested on all three routes.

Claude owner metadata deliberately refuses missing registered static rules. Frozen preserves that boundary and directs users to inspect/restore or explicitly rebuild a baseline through normal management.
The lock has no settings-value digest. Only exact keys and approved effects are provable; a changed unused value with identical effects is allowed. Do not claim byte-level settings-value identity.
Changed executable path/bindings require explicit ordinary management before frozen. Cross-root relocation, project/cloud/plugin expansion belong to D3.
Cooperative guard and runtime rollback do not promise same-user adversarial exclusion, old-writer coordination, global multi-file crash atomicity or power-loss recovery.
Fixtures, CLI canaries and raw runtime calls do not prove real harness loading/trust/delivery, Windows or remote CI; local encodings do not replace official counting.
